summary: France's flag carrier, hub at Paris-Charles de Gaulle; part of Air France-KLM.
checkin: Online check-in opens 30 hours before departure.
baggage: Economy cabin bags: 1 small bag plus 0 or 1 piece of hand baggage depending on the fare, 12 kg total. Light fares include no checked bag; one can be bought as an extra.
tips: Pick your seat and get your boarding pass when you check in online.
